name: branding-monoline-knight-on-horse-with-embossed-leather-and-card
title: Single-line knight on a rearing horse, blind-embossed on suede and on a seeded-paper card
whatItIs: A white slide with a black monoline knight with sword on a rearing horse, the caption 'wildcrest leather accessories', and two photos: the mark debossed into brown suede and a cream speckled card with the mark and vertical text held against a rust shirt pocket.
whatItMeans: Adventurous and crafted; a single line feels hand-drawn and works well pressed into leather.
techniques: Draw an animated figure in one line weight.

vocabulary.definition: A drawing in a single line weight.
A design pressed into a surface.
A logo suited to hand-made goods.
